digest.component_or_area: CLI / command-line parsing and help generation
propositions: Current CLI syntax is fragmented across 54 hand-maintained package-help files, 22 curated intercept descriptions, and multiple imperative argv loops, causing drift between parser, runtime help, and documentation

Single-source argparse factories must be established as the authoritative grammar definition, with deterministic formatters and registry validation rejecting duplicates, contradictions, and missing references
All command families (core, advanced, bridge, reconciler, LLM, workflow, audit, identity) must migrate from imperative parsing to pure side-effect-free factory functions

Generated package-help and grouped-overview artifacts must be byte-deterministic and regenerable, with top-level routing recognizing only global config tokens, command identity, and help forms before delegating to handler factories
Parser migrations must preserve production-path behavior (argv acceptance/rejection, diagnostics, exit codes, streams) verified by oracle tests before atomic runtime/factory switchover
Compatibility shims and the old execution ladder remain unchanged; retirement of imperative parsers and docs-only grammars is prohibited until all child migrations complete
